up: For assay CHEMBL3705858, list compounds with exact activity measurements (standard_relation = '='). Return canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, standard relation, standard value, and standard units.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units
FROM assays ass
JOIN activities a ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3705858'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
